query: About twenty minutes after takeoff a flight attendant called to say there was a strong burning or dirty-sock smell in the aft cabin. Shortly afterwards we smelled it on the flight deck too. We put on our oxygen masks, declared an emergency and returned to the departure airport. Maintenance could not find the source.
relevance_criterion: the event centres on fumes, smoke smell or an air-quality/odour event in the cabin or flight deck

query: On a visual approach about four miles behind a heavy jet the aircraft suddenly rolled about 30 degrees to the left and the autopilot disconnected. We recovered and continued the approach but I think the spacing behind the heavy was too tight.
relevance_criterion: wake turbulence (encounter or wake separation) is central to the event

query: It was the last leg of a four day trip with a short overnight and both of us were exhausted. I caught myself nodding off in cruise and later we missed a checklist item on the approach. Fatigue from the schedule was the main factor.
relevance_criterion: the reporter describes crew tiredness, sleep loss or fatigue as part of the event

query: While flying in the traffic pattern another small aircraft appeared from our left at the same altitude and we had to make an aggressive evasive turn. We passed within a few hundred feet. Neither of us had been told about the other.
relevance_criterion: an airborne near mid-air collision or evasive manoeuvre to avoid another aircraft

query: Climbing out of 4000 feet TCAS gave us a traffic alert followed by a 'Descend, Descend' resolution advisory for a VFR target. We followed the RA, told ATC, then returned to our clearance.
relevance_criterion: a TCAS traffic or resolution advisory is a central part of the event

theme: runway excursion / loss of directional control
query: During the landing rollout a gust pushed the aircraft to the left and I lost directional control. We departed the side of the runway into the grass and damaged the propeller and gear.
relevance_criterion: the aircraft left the runway surface or the pilot lost directional control on the runway

query: At the gate we found that a lithium battery shipment and a passenger's electric wheelchair had been loaded in the cargo hold without the required dangerous goods paperwork or a Notice to Captain.
relevance_criterion: dangerous goods / hazmat handling or documentation problems

query: Early in the takeoff roll the takeoff configuration warning sounded, so the captain rejected the takeoff. Everything looked normal afterwards and we returned to the gate for maintenance.
relevance_criterion: a rejected takeoff triggered by an aircraft warning or malfunction

query: In cruise the fuel quantity indications for one tank started fluctuating and then failed, and we got a fuel imbalance message. We were not sure how much fuel we really had, so we worked through the checklist with dispatch.
relevance_criterion: fuel quantity indication failure, fuel imbalance or unreliable fuel gauging

query: In a busy approach environment we never switched to the tower frequency and landed without a landing clearance. We only realised when ground control asked if we had talked to tower.
relevance_criterion: the crew landed without a landing clearance

query: Taxiing out we were told to hold short of the runway but missed the faded hold short markings and crossed the line while another aircraft was on short final. Tower stopped us.
relevance_criterion: a runway incursion, hold-short line crossing or runway crossing/takeoff conflict

query: Descending through flight level 300 we hit severe clear air turbulence with large altitude and airspeed excursions. A flight attendant in the aft galley was thrown to the floor and injured.
relevance_criterion: severe turbulence or atmospheric waves affecting the flight (not wake turbulence)

query: Shortly after levelling off the hydraulic quantity on one system began dropping and eventually the system failed. We ran the abnormal checklist, requested priority handling and diverted.
relevance_criterion: a hydraulic system leak or failure

query: While pulling into the gate the wingtip struck a catering truck that was parked close to the safety zone. The marshaller had given us a normal stop signal.
relevance_criterion: aircraft struck, nearly struck or rolled toward a vehicle, equipment or object on the ground

query: At about 3000 feet on approach a small drone passed very close to our left wing. We reported the position and description to the approach controller.
relevance_criterion: an unmanned aircraft (drone/UAS) sighting, strike or operation

theme: automation failed to level off / capture
query: We were descending in VNAV with the altitude set in the MCP but the autopilot did not level off and we went several hundred feet below our assigned altitude before we caught it.
relevance_criterion: autopilot/FMS failed to level off or capture the selected altitude or vertical path

query: After departure dispatch sent us a message that our weight and balance was wrong because the bag count and cargo positions used in the load sheet did not match what was actually loaded.
relevance_criterion: weight and balance or load documentation errors

query: During a component change the technician reconnected two lines in the wrong positions. The error was not caught by the leak check or inspection and the aircraft was returned to service.
relevance_criterion: a maintenance error in installation, repair or servicing that reached the aircraft

query: After takeoff the landing gear would not retract and we got an unsafe gear indication. We left the gear down, ran the checklist and returned to land.
relevance_criterion: landing gear failed to retract or gave unsafe indications after takeoff

query: Two aircraft on the frequency had similar call signs and the controller was speaking very fast. We accepted a descent clearance that was meant for the other aircraft.
relevance_criterion: radio communication confusion: similar call signs, unclear or non-English ATC speech, clearance taken by the wrong aircraft
